body: @FY-Summer could you give a runnable repro? thanks!

@BoyuanFeng，thanks for your reply. I originally intended to extract the problematic code as an executable script, but I found that the error scenario was not consistent. Therefore, the current reproduction method may be a bit cumbersome：
1) I think you need a docker container that includes torch 2.4.1 and Transformer Engine, etc.
2) Training code: https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/core_r0.10.0/
3) Dataset processing:
Download the original dataset(execute the following commands in the Megatron-LM root directory):
```
mkdir mixtral_dataset
cd mixtral_dataset
wget https://huggingface.co/bigscience/misc-test-data/blob/main/stas/oscar-1GB.jsonl.xz
xz -dk oscar-1GB.jsonl.xz
download tokenizer.model, which might involve authentication issues. Address: https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mixtral-8x7B-v0.1/blob/main/tokenizer.model
cd ..
```
Preprocess the dataset(execute the following script in the Megatron-LM root directory):
```
python tools/preprocess_data.py \
       --input ./mixtral_dataset/oscar-1GB.jsonl \
       --output-prefix ./mixtral_dataset/my-mixtral\
       --tokenizer-type Llama2Tokenizer \
       --tokenizer-model ./mixtral_dataset/tokenizer.model \
       --workers 16 \
       --append-eod
```
4) Training script(Place in the root directory of the training code.):
```
#!/bin/bash

# Runs Mixtral 8x7B model

export CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=1

rm -rf ./CKPT
GPUS_PER_NODE=4
# Change for multinode config
MASTER_ADDR=${MASTER_ADDR:-"localhost"}
MASTER_PORT=${MASTER_PORT:-"6000"}
NNODES=${SLURM_NNODES:-"1"}
NODE_RANK=${RANK:-"0"}
WORLD_SIZE=$(($GPUS_PER_NODE*$NNODES))

CHECKPOINT_PATH=./CKPT 
TOKENIZER_MODEL=./mixtral_dataset/tokenizer.model
DATA_PATH=./mixtral_dataset/my-mixtral_text_document

DISTRIBUTED_ARGS=(
    --nproc_per_node $GPUS_PER_NODE
    --nnodes $NNODES
    --node_rank $NODE_RANK
    --master_addr $MASTER_ADDR
    --master_port $MASTER_PORT
)

MODEL_ARGS=(
    --use-mcore-models
    --disable-bias-linear
    --seq-length 1024
    --max-position-embeddings 32768
    --num-layers 4
    --hidden-size 4096
    --ffn-hidden-size 14336
    --num-attention-heads 32
    --init-method-std 0.01
    --attention-dropout 0.0
    --hidden-dropout 0.0
    --normalization RMSNorm
    --position-embedding-type rope
    --swiglu
    --untie-embeddings-and-output-weights
    --group-query-attention
    --num-query-groups 8
    --no-masked-softmax-fusion
    --no-position-embedding
    --rotary-base 1000000
)

MOE_ARGS=(
    --num-experts 8
    --moe-router-topk 2
    --moe-router-load-balancing-type aux_loss
    --moe-aux-loss-coeff 1e-2
    --moe-grouped-gemm
    --moe-token-dispatcher-type alltoall
    --overlap-param-gather
    --overlap-grad-reduce
)

DATA_ARGS=(
    --tokenizer-type Llama2Tokenizer
    --tokenizer-model ${TOKENIZER_MODEL}
    --data-path $DATA_PATH
    --split 99990,8,2
)

TRAINING_ARGS=(
    --micro-batch-size 1
    --global-batch-size 4
    --lr 1e-4
    --train-iters 10
    --lr-decay-iters 320000
    --lr-decay-style cosine
    --min-lr 1.0e-5
    --weight-decay 0.1
    --lr-warmup-iters 500
    --clip-grad 1.0
    --bf16
)

MODEL_PARALLEL_ARGS=(
    --tensor-model-parallel-size 2
    --pipeline-model-parallel-size 1
    --expert-model-parallel-size 2
    --use-distributed-optimizer
    --sequence-parallel
)

LOGGING_ARGS=(
    --log-throughput \
    --log-interval 1 \
    --save-interval 10000 \
    --eval-interval 1000 \
    --eval-iters 10 \
    --save $CHECKPOINT_PATH \
    --load $CHECKPOINT_PATH \
    --tensorboard-dir "${CHECKPOINT_PATH}/tensorboard" \
    --no-load-optim \
    --no-load-rng
)

if [ -n "${WANDB_API_KEY}" ]; then
    LOGGING_ARGS+=(
        --wandb-project ${WANDB_PROJECT:-"Mixtral"}
        --wandb-exp-name ${WANDB_NAME:-"Mixtral_8x7B"}
    )
fi


torchrun ${DISTRIBUTED_ARGS[@]} pretrain_gpt.py \
    ${MODEL_ARGS[@]} \
    ${MOE_ARGS[@]} \
    ${DATA_ARGS[@]} \
    ${TRAINING_ARGS[@]} \
    ${MODEL_PARALLEL_ARGS[@]} \
    ${LOGGING_ARGS[@]}

```

@BoyuanFeng Hello, I realized that I wasn't using `torch.compiler.cudagraph_mark_step_begin()` correctly. 

In this particular scenario, forward  of a single step involves multiple calls to topk_softmax_with_capacity. 
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2c3e997b-f116-4b6b-a3dc-6652d50803f4)

At the beginning, I attempted to place `torch.compiler.cudagraph_mark_step_begin()` directly at the location where `topk_softmax_with_capacity` is called. this led to the deallocation of the outputs from earlier `topk_softmax_with_capacity` calls within the same forward function, which in turn caused the aforementioned error during the backpropagation phase.
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4db3947d-93cf-4ebb-8c3d-259977646574)

I tried placing `torch.compiler.cudagraph_mark_step_begin()` before the step function, and the aforementioned error has now disappeared. However, I feel that the state transitions are somewhat slow (related to the model structure, NONE -> WARMUP -> RECORDING -> EXECUTION). I'm curious if `topk_softmax_with_capacity `can transition directly from NONE -> WARMUP -> RECORDING -> EXECUTION within a single forward pass?
